# apple_merchant_ids (Data Source)

Lists the merchant IDs that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_merchant_ids" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identifiers` (Set of String) Identifiers to match.
- `names` (Set of String) Names to match.

### Read-Only

- `merchant_ids` (Attributes List) The matching merchant IDs, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--merchant_ids))

<a id="nestedatt--merchant_ids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `merchant_ids`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the merchant ID.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier, e.g. `merchant.com.example`.
- `name` (String) Description of the merchant ID.
